metadata.name: Amber Fifty
metadata.author: Pedaleira
metadata.summary: A British-style 50 W crunch amp: a 12AX7 input stage, the gain pot, two cascaded 12AX7 stages, a treble, middle and bass tone stack, a master volume and a push-pull pair of EL34 with global feedback and a presence control. A typical topology of the kind, not the schematic of one product; its values were fitted to measurements of a reference amp (its GAIN sweep, its response with every knob at 5 and its tone knob sweeps). Every value the fit moved is marked "fitted" with what it was fitted to.
references: D. T. Yeh and J. O. Smith, the closed-form analysis of the treble, middle and bass tone stack, DAFx-06, 2006
J. Pakarinen and D. T. Yeh, A review of digital techniques for modeling vacuum-tube guitar amplifiers, Computer Music Journal 33(2), 2009

Pedaleira measurements of a reference amp played through a modelling unit's USB input: GAIN sweeps with a 1 kHz staircase, THD at the staircase's -18 dBFS step, the test signal's sweeps and the tone knob sweeps (2026), with the signal 36 dB under its nominal level
